name: Natsu no Arashi
source:
A social studies teacher Takakura Saki goes after Aoi Hazuki, one of her students, as Aoi enters in an empty classroom... As soon as she reached the classroom, Hazuki heard a quarrel of a boy and a girl from the classroom...

A visual novel about a futanari girl and a female teacher.

[description from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051178.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
社會科教師高倉麻紀尾隨學生葵葉月進入空教室……葉月剛到教室，便聽見裡面傳來一男一女的爭吵聲……

一部講述扶他少女與女教師的視覺小說。

[簡介譯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051178.html]英文版DLsite[/url]]
